notes.title: Kaz's Adventure 2: Frozen Kingdom [DLC 2]
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Frozen Kingdom![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/beea513fc70368c6a0fd8edcbc3b76c595898492.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]New Tool[/h3][p]Within the DLC 2 levels there will be new grapple hook tools you can pick up to traverse levels horizontally or vertically and you can hook onto walls, cellings or enemies to complete levels.
[/p][p]The grapple hook will also be in the Level Editor for everyone to use even if you dont have the upcoming DLC 2.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Levels[/h3][p]Kaz's Adventure 2: Frozen Kingdom features 8 new levels for players to complete with the new Frozen Kingdom enviroment being featured.[/p][p][/p][p]The last level in the DLC will also be a boss fight against the evil Ice King in a climatic final battle to Kaz's Revenge Story.[/p][p][/p][h3]Final Chapter to the Story[/h3][p]This DLC will be the last entry in the current overarching story for the series which we have dubbed Kaz's Revenge Story, this DLC will explore Kaz searching for a hidden power that may allow him to escape the underworld and have a new lease on life serving as a end for the events started in Kaz's Adventure [i](2022)[/i].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]DLC 2 - Kaz's Adventure 2: Frozen Kingdom is expected to launch January 2026 although we know for sure it'll release in 2026, the month may change.[/p][p][/p][p]We expect to provide more details and gameplay footage at a later date.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Wishlist Now:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546670/Kazs_Adventure_2_Frozen_Kingdom/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Level Editor 2.0 | Full Details
notes.content: [h1]Level Editor 2.0[/h1][p][/p][h2]"Create Your Own Adventure"[/h2][p][/p][h3]Releases [b]11th July 2025[/b][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/f973b4eddb07fe5909ee716de6f0e14807a29338.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/7c946c4a4390e6dad367f86551f238aaec58695a.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Tons of Level Elements[/h3][p]When the Level Editor 2.0 mode releases there will be around 2.5 pages full of tiles with more being added in future updates, with the tiles provided you can create your own levels with enemies, lava, classic art style, new art style and more.[/p][p][/p][p]There are 58 Level Elements included with the modes releases mainly comprising of Kaz's Adventure 2 and DLC elements but we hope in the future to bring more elements into the mode from classic to modern styles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/bd349eab86016586c0a5b02991ede2dc8fe8244f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/938e69dcc2e3a618792a6d14ef7e8f7dd4a2f8ec.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/095ad3cc4549641d03a3a5de136fbe274f215f8e.png"][/img][/p][p][i][Page 3 is a early beta screenshot and is missing one element, Temple Boulder][/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Blast from the Past[/h3][p]You may have noticed that Page 3 includes classic tiles, in Level Editor 2.0 you can merge both old and new to create a new adventure of your own, you can have a classic location and new tiles or a new location and classic tiles, the choice is up to you, more classic tiles and locations may be added in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/b002897b1b25cf1e93e55a987c3cd4b0159bcd4c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Change the Levels Location[/h3][p]When the mode releases there will be 15 locations for you to create your new levels in from the base game, DLC's and previous game entries like Kaz's Adventure [i](2022)[/i], it is up to you where your next adventure takes place.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/36cec380b9ab5c01df27fe865b31c5c6236c245a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/958f6c3a92963974dce274ddf9e64363f693ee34.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Save and Load up to 8 Levels[/h3][p]Once you have fully designed your level you can save your creation to one of the 8 level slots which can be loaded at anytime, you can even continue designing your level at a later date.[/p][p][/p][p]More save slots will be added in future updates.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Share your Adventures Online[/h3][p]Levels will be saved within the "Custom Levels" folder in the root of the game files, these files can then be shared online where others can download and store them in one of the 8 save slots provided.[/p][p][/p][p]Each level file is tied to a save slot, numbered Slot 1 through Slot 8. When downloading a level, you can rename the file to any available slot. For example, if the level was originally saved to Slot 5 but you already have something saved there, just rename it to Slot 8 (or another free slot). The game will then load it from the newly assigned slot.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Toggle the Weather in any Location[/h3][p]When creating your new adventures, you can toggle the weather by clicking the rain cloud icon in the tool bar on the left side of the screen, rain will make you stages audio have more reverb and apply a rain effect to the entire stage adding greater atmosphere to your levels.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Check out the Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls Roadmap![/h2][p][/p][p][url="https://trello.com/b/oYzXOr9b/kazs-adventure-2-lost-souls-development-board" style="button" buttoncolor="#000000"]Trello Board[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Major Update #2 - The Level Creation Update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes to Names for Major Updates[/h2]
For Kaz's Adventure (2022.) and Physics Lab (2023.), we used a simple naming system for our major updates being Major Update #1, Major Update #2 and so on but with this game, it's support is planned to last longer then the previous two games and as such it would be better to give each major update its own name rather then get to a point when major updates are called something like "Major Update #55".

Starting with the originally named Major Update #2, every major update will now have its own name with the next one being called The Level Creation Update, see below for further details.

[h2]The Level Creation Update - V1.2.2[/h2]
The Level Creation Update will add the instantly unlocked Level Editor 2.0 mode which first appeared in Kaz's Adventure (2022.) as a secret unlockable mode after collecting a particular amount of power jars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/10cd4e382cf0d32258feb3460fa5c9f9f100995c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/e480a1d1ad60546029aa82e41f36fa68c617e146.png[/img]

This level editor will be a massive improvement on the original 2022 mode with grid snap, camera movement, more tiles, custom level saves and more, I don't want to reveal to much about the mode as there will be alot you can do in this mode and we plan to add to the mode in future updates too.

V1.2.2 will also bring some extra additions like a redesign of the main menu, reorganised way to access your paid content and French localisation.

[i]We hope to bring you our biggest update yet around Q3 2025.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/2d59f3b5b44cc54a0a39c188b6236ee3b144a46e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/884be614f2940e059b863157164725ac10adb88f.png[/img]

notes.title: Kaz's Adventure 2: Legacy - DLC Announcement
notes.content:
[u][b][h1]Kaz's Adventure 2: Legacy DLC - Coming Soon![/h1][/b][/u]

[h2]Reimagined and Improved:[/h2]
[i]Kaz's Adventure 2: Legacy is a Paid DLC expansion for Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls that will release in 2025 and will include 8 levels with new / returning environments from Kaz's Adventure (2022.), 6 levels will be reimagined versions of the original games World 1 and two completely new levels using the level design philosophy of Kaz's Adventure (2022.).[/i]

[h2]Classic Features and Enemies:[/h2]
[i]Kaz's Adventure 2: Legacy will return to the original camera follow system of Kaz's Adventure (2022.) where it will follow Kaz on both the X and Y axis during gameplay, enemies will also only be from the Kaz's Adventure (2022.) selection pool, so there won't be any skeletons or other underworld elements.[/i]

An old enemy thought to be dead makes a epic return in the final level of this expansion in a climatic boss fight.

[h2]Timeline / Story:[/h2]
[i]I won't confirm if this takes place before or after Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls main story, mainly to avoid spoilers for the base games ending and the DLCs ending but it's timeline placement is a main part of the DLCs story and it is canon to the storyline unlike previous DLC.[/i]

[h2]Extra Content:[/h2]
[i]Along with the 8 levels you will also automatically unlock 4 free cosmetics that will be announced at a later date.

In addition to all, survival mode will get 3 new environments added that can be randomly selected once you unlock survival mode.[/i]

notes.title: Cosmetics & Spirit Gems
notes.content:
[h2]What are spirit gems?[/h2]

Spirit Gems are a new collectible which act as a currency for the spirit shop, in the spirit shops you can purchase cosmetics, lives and soul orbs in different quantities, each enemy you defeat will grant you 10 gems and every level has around 100-140 gems excluding enemies so you shouldn't have to grind for hours just for one single trail.



[h2]What types of cosmetics are there?[/h2]

At launch there will only be one type of cosmetic which will be trails you can equip to Kaz but in future major updates there will be more types of cosmetics added, one idea for other cosmetics currently being floated around is Pets which would follow Kaz throughout the levels.

[i]Note: Cosmetics are not reset upon selecting new game and neither is your soul orbs and spirit gems, this is so you can continue to use your rewards and soul orbs as a weird new game plus.[/i]



[h2]How many cosmetics will there be from launch?[/h2]

From launch there will be 10 trails for you to purchase with spirit gems from the store, this should require you to back track through levels to obtain all of them but you can still get a decent handful (of your choice) from playing naturally.

notes.title: Survival Mode & Soul Orbs
notes.content:
[h2]What are Soul Orbs?[/h2]

Soul Orbs are a collectible which serve the same kind of purpose as the "Jars Of Power" from Kaz's Adventure (2022.), They unlock a save star which shows up on your main menu (75 souls orbs) and unlocks survival mode (15 souls orbs) and a secret mode (30 soul orbs) that I'll leave as a surprise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945380/e7730775069927888a7e1bc67cf6d3e7f8d2fd83.png[/img]

[h2]What is Survival Mode?[/h2]

Survival Mode is a arcade style mode where you must survive on a small platform while the Cloaked try and cause you to fail, you are timed in this mode with the ability to capture your score at the end and compare it to your high score.



[h2]Secret Mode?[/h2]

I won't spoil much but this mode will contain its own (not story related) set of small bite size levels players can go through, the mode can be unlocked once you have 30 soul orbs and there will be 6 levels at launch with more being added in future updates.

notes.title: Details On Some Of The Major Story Changes.
notes.content:
[h2]The Entire Story For Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls Has Changed.[/h2]
[i]Recently I realised that 5 worlds was a bit too much due to current resources and that meant one had to be cut which led to story rewrites and then the entire games story got changed, Kaz does still die in the opening and he does still travel the underworld but the whole plot point of Kaz trying to revive himself has been scrapped and instead he's trying to reunite with his brother Ash who died in the prologue of Kaz's Adventure 1, He will still visit the same places as originally planned but he just won't be reviving himself.[/i]

[i]The world that was cut was Kaz reliving the prologue of Kaz's Adventure 1 and his village being attacked this has been cut due to him not needing to visit his memories anymore to revive himself, instead we can put more of a focus on Kaz's relationship with his race and brother plus also tie both the kaz games closer together.[/i]

[i]Sorry for anyone who wanted to see something like that but one of the perks of staying in the underworld is we can always bring that plot back at a later date plus explore more of the underworld, the underworld in the game is a dark but also lively world full of new creatures, removing this world has also allowed for more enemy and NPC types so expect some info on new characters and enemies soon![/i]

[h2]When Is Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls Releasing?[/h2]
[i]I'm starting to get a better guess on when this will be and development has been going at a rapid pace at the moment, Kaz 2's final trailer will drop sometime around june ish and that will include a concrete not changing release date along with more focus on unseen worlds.[/i]
